purpose: Reviewed, reproducible fresh M1 schema staging plan. This file describes transformations; the generator emits a destination-specific manifest with exact source hashes.

policy.sourceHashes: SHA-256 for every selected migration is written to generated manifest.json
policy.databaseCollationSha256: SHA-256 of server/bootstrap/m1/database-collation.sql; the generator refuses to stage if it differs

stagingOrder: 20260920_00_a_m1_database_collation.sql, then all tracked server/migrations/YYYYMMDD_*.sql and 20260920_00z_m1_prelude.sql in lexical filename order

transforms.issue: Fresh bootstrap failed with ERROR 3780 at 20260920_05_instructor_system.sql line 19: MySQL 8.0's server default collation (utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci) makes the legacy baseline's users(id) incompatible with the explicit utf8mb4_unicode_ci columns and tables of later migrations that reference it. Converting already-created tables is impossible without disabling foreign-key checks (ALTER TABLE ... CONVERT TO CHARACTER SET fails on either side of an incompatible FK pair).
transforms.resolution: Stage as 20260920_00_a_m1_database_collation.sql before the legacy baseline; it sets the database default to utf8mb4/utf8mb4_unicode_ci so every table created without an explicit charset - baseline and later migrations alike - is utf8mb4_unicode_ci and all foreign keys are compatible. No historical migration is edited; no foreign-key check is disabled.

transforms.issue: References lectures before any tracked migration creates it.
transforms.resolution: Prelude creates the minimum compatible lectures shape without price, archived_at, or instructor_id; the source migration then adds instructor_id unchanged.
These columns are deliberately absent from the prelude and remain owned by this unchanged source migration.

Move only the exact reviewed groups ALTER to 20260920_00z_m1_prelude.sql after legacy baseline creates groups and before 20260925 enrollment dependency; retain all other source bytes and fail if the exact statement differs.

transforms.issue: Contains dynamic CREATE TABLE lectures fallback.
transforms.resolution: Copied unchanged. Its INFORMATION_SCHEMA guard makes the reviewed prelude-created table skip the fallback.
